\chapter{Per-Instance Results of the Full Protocol}\label{AppendixB}
Table~\ref{tab:fullinst} lists, for each of the 60 benchmark instances, the published ES-TRMP result and the result with the contiguous (\texttt{block}) destroy at $\kappa=4$ under the paper's protocol (4{,}000 iterations, 20 runs, seeds $1,\ldots,20$). Mean is the average over 20 runs and Best the best of 20 (radians); the change is relative to ES-TRMP and negative is better. Instance names are abbreviated: \texttt{m400-s06-i02} is \texttt{covers\_dirn400m240r150s06i02}; \texttt{s03}, \texttt{s04}, \texttt{s06} are the sensing angles $2\pi/3$, $\pi/2$, $\pi/3$.
